# ReceiptOS Verify v0.2.0 — generic claim boundary and Trustless-native verification

**Experimental prerelease.** ReceiptOS Verify v0.2 evaluates what supplied evidence establishes for a caller-selected claim across claim, subject, artifact, authority, scope, policy/version, time, assumptions and dependencies.

Release target: `396143120f787d2f5534e92c0cf896c029a05775` (tree `4cbfcdcf323e18978268cab4c6870ae693a281b9`). This merge tree is byte-identical to the independently audited candidate `c617bd8cec6649cd25833e59a02cf823fc2198fc`.

## What changed since v0.1.0

- Generalized the original commit A/B witness into a typed generic claim boundary.
- Added executable public/neutral Semantic ABI compatibility checks while keeping native Semantic ABI results separate from the product projection.
- Added a pinned Trustless/recompute-kit integration that preserves native check/case identity, verdicts, grades, pins and replay status instead of treating process success as semantic success.
- Added an Interpoll signed-action/retry adapter that keeps authorization, exact intent, retry, execution attempt and observation distinct.
- Added bounded PRF guarantee-preservation projection with `PRESERVED`, `VIOLATED` and `UNVERIFIABLE` kept separate from upstream native verdicts.
- Preserved the v0.1 corpus and semantics while extending the product projection and UI around the same evidence-boundary discipline.

## Independent release audit

The first frozen v0.2 candidate (`4888a058...`) did **not** pass the independent release audit. The audit reproduced defects in caller-requirement admission, continuity handling and mutation-kill classification. Those findings were recorded first, then repaired in separate commits and rerun from fresh checkouts.

Final repaired gate:

- **707/707 tests** in normal, no-opt and repeat modes
- **68/68 vectors** (30 unchanged v0.1 + 38 v0.2)
- **14/14 + 14/14 semantic mutation catalogue kills**, with non-semantic outcomes kept distinct
- **57/57** independent generic/adversarial probes
- **3238/3238** finite product-projection cases
- **51/51** domain integration checks
- **16/16** mutation negative controls
- **14/14** fresh end-to-end demos
- **30/30** complete v0.1 semantic-report comparisons unchanged
- source lock, provenance, licensing and determinism checks passed

GitHub Linux pinned-candidate CI: https://github.com/pipavlo82/receiptos-verify/actions/runs/38186938612

Full audit: https://github.com/pipavlo82/receiptos-verify/blob/396143120f787d2f5534e92c0cf896c029a05775/RELEASE_AUDIT_v0.2.md

Vector witness matrix: https://github.com/pipavlo82/receiptos-verify/blob/396143120f787d2f5534e92c0cf896c029a05775/V0_2_VECTOR_WITNESS_MATRIX.md

## Important boundaries

This release keeps native results and product-level meaning separate. In particular:

- integrity or authenticity alone does not imply semantic `VERIFIED`;
- evidence for subject/claim A does not establish subject/claim B;
- `REPRODUCED` does not mean the reproduced native verdict is positive;
- upstream guarantee validity does not imply downstream preservation;
- signature validity does not authorize a materially changed agent action;
- matching digests do not override Semantic ABI incompatibility.

The Trustless adapter remains pinned to the audited historical recompute-kit state used by this release. `recompute-kit` PR #57 merged after that audit, so v0.2.0 does **not** claim support for the newly merged reporter protocol.

No provider/hardware/server-SQL/chain authenticity, arbitrary semantic entailment, full upstream conformance, real ML-DSA backend or live XRPL ledger anchor is claimed.

## Licensing

New ReceiptOS Verify repository-authored material is licensed under Apache-2.0, Copyright 2026 Pavlo Tvardovskyi. Upstream, vendored, captured and separately licensed material retains its original provenance and terms; see `PROVENANCE.md`, `LICENSING.md` and the source inventory for exact boundaries.

PR #1: https://github.com/pipavlo82/receiptos-verify/pull/1

body:
# v0.1.0 — first public release candidate

**Experimental prerelease.** ReceiptOS Verify is a local verifier for what supplied evidence establishes for a caller-selected claim. This release targets `62cd3e59c8f568496ed087d55f0aec3d63363b0a` (tree `8a5de5a3735e04f3f45cf164b59da17289693bc2`). It does not approve the rejected historical candidate `33d8ee47ad733f1198f2b2fb8d171b31c7b10678`.

The repository is now public at [pipavlo82/receiptos-verify](https://github.com/pipavlo82/receiptos-verify). The candidate README's “no remote” statement describes its earlier local state and is superseded by this publication notice. Frozen audit observations remain historical evidence.

## Included

- Pinned native Crystal integrity and RVR predicate/replay operations, with native negative outcomes preserved.
- Exact subject/policy binding, Ed25519 authentication, finite QEV postprocessing, bounded public-spec relation adapters, portable product capsules and a localhost inspection UI.
- 12 registered surfaces: 11 bounded executable/admission surfaces and one ledger interface. Capability maturity is 2 STABLE, 9 EXPERIMENTAL and 1 INTERFACE_ONLY. The 21 named implemented slices also include methodology work; they are not 21 native adapters.

## Validation and publication evidence

The earlier repaired-runtime audit at `b893eeb1b22eada6431d7b2e819439e9f4f67414` recorded 275 tests, 30 literal vectors, 14 applied catalog mutation kills and 269 independently constructed semantic probes. The 269 probes were not rerun for publication. Runtime/test/vendor/dependency bytes remain unchanged in the public candidate; subsequent documentation/presentation changes are recorded separately. These are finite inventories, not exhaustive conformance or 14 independent security properties.

The CI controller is `a7b3c90c4ba8cde1d2eabad2683e5e525acbd311` on `codex/ci-v0.1.0`. Its workflow checks out candidate `62cd3e59c8f568496ed087d55f0aec3d63363b0a` explicitly. The controller is not merged into `main` and is not the release target.

- [GitHub CI on Ubuntu 24.04](https://github.com/pipavlo82/receiptos-verify/actions/runs/38172749060): **PASS** — exact candidate/tree above, 275/275 tests with zero failures/skips, 30/30 vectors and 14/14 applied semantic kills with all positive controls preserved. All other mutation categories are zero.
- Fresh clone from public GitHub, detached at the same SHA, reproduced on Windows after CI: **PASS** — 275/275 tests, 30/30 vectors, 14/14 applied semantic kills, all positive controls preserved and no crashes/skips. Dependencies were installed in that clone using a new empty npm cache, without borrowing the earlier checkout's files.
- Both runs passed source-lock and `git diff --check` before/after, CLI/capsule demos and V02 local reproduction. Same authentic/intact receipt: requested commit A -> `VERIFIED`; requested B -> subject-binding and overall `CONTRADICTED`, with integrity/authenticity still `VERIFIED` and native replay `REPRODUCED`.
- Tested runtimes: Node 22.15.0, npm 10.9.2, Python 3.12.10 and Bun 1.3.14. Windows native execution currently expects Bun at `C:/Users/msi/.bun/bin/bun.exe`; arbitrary Windows-host portability is not established.
- [Publication evidence ZIP](https://github.com/pipavlo82/receiptos-verify/releases/download/v0.1.0/receiptos-verify-v0.1.0-publication-evidence.zip) includes original CI archives, raw outputs, command/digest receipts, fresh remote-checkout results and the first failed run. [SHA256SUMS](https://github.com/pipavlo82/receiptos-verify/releases/download/v0.1.0/SHA256SUMS) identifies the archive.

Local audit, CI and remote counts are separate observations and are not added together. These executions do not claim a second independent human operator.


## Known fresh-checkout test setup limitation

The [first GitHub CI attempt](https://github.com/pipavlo82/receiptos-verify/actions/runs/38172603349) failed: 258 tests registered, 257 passed and one failed. `tests/git.test.mjs` assumes the parent `reports/tmp` directory already exists before calling `mkdtemp`; a fresh Git checkout omits this ignored directory. The early harness failure means this run did not complete the intended full inventory. This release does not claim out-of-box `npm test` success on a bare checkout.

Before running tests in a fresh checkout, create the empty parent directory:

```sh
node --input-type=module -e "import { mkdirSync } from 'node:fs'; mkdirSync('reports/tmp', { recursive: true });"
npm test
```

The revised CI controller records this setup and creates an initially absent, empty `reports/tmp`. It injects no evidence, fixtures or dependency cache. The release candidate remains unchanged; the first failure remains part of the published validation history.

## Boundaries

No provider/hardware authenticity, real ML-DSA backend, live ledger inclusion/finality, complete global Chronicle history or production security certification is established. Chronicle compares supplied continuity/reference strings; it does not calculate or verify aggregate roots. V09 checks producer execution-declaration completeness while native RVR runs. The local UI is not a production hosted service. The audit is implementation-independent local review, not organizationally independent certification.

New repository-authored material is Apache-2.0, Copyright 2026 Pavlo Tvardovskyi. Selected upstream, nested and npm components retain their own licenses, notices and contribution attribution. Repository ownership, requirements/review, fork lineage and original implementation authorship remain distinct.

Read the [release audit](https://github.com/pipavlo82/receiptos-verify/blob/62cd3e59c8f568496ed087d55f0aec3d63363b0a/RELEASE_AUDIT_v0.1.md), [vector matrix](https://github.com/pipavlo82/receiptos-verify/blob/62cd3e59c8f568496ed087d55f0aec3d63363b0a/VECTOR_WITNESS_MATRIX.md), [mutation audit](https://github.com/pipavlo82/receiptos-verify/blob/62cd3e59c8f568496ed087d55f0aec3d63363b0a/MUTATION_AUDIT.md), [trust boundaries](https://github.com/pipavlo82/receiptos-verify/blob/62cd3e59c8f568496ed087d55f0aec3d63363b0a/docs/trust-boundaries.md), [provenance](https://github.com/pipavlo82/receiptos-verify/blob/62cd3e59c8f568496ed087d55f0aec3d63363b0a/PROVENANCE.md) and [licensing](https://github.com/pipavlo82/receiptos-verify/blob/62cd3e59c8f568496ed087d55f0aec3d63363b0a/LICENSING.md) for exact scope and evidence.
